chinese: 要不是老師的鼓勵，他早就放棄學英文了。
reference: If it had not been for the teacher's encouragement, he would have given up learning English long ago.

chinese: 這座城市之所以吸引這麼多遊客，是因為它同時保留了傳統與現代。
reference: This city attracts so many tourists because it preserves both tradition and modernity at the same time.

chinese: 無論你多忙，都應該找時間運動。
reference: No matter how busy you are, you should find time to exercise.

chinese: 直到看了那部紀錄片，我才意識到海洋污染有多嚴重。
reference: It was not until I watched that documentary that I realized how serious ocean pollution was.

chinese: 這項政策雖立意良善，卻沒有考慮到偏鄉居民的實際需求。
reference: Although this policy was well-intentioned, it failed to consider the actual needs of residents in remote areas.

chinese: 科學家們正在研究氣候變遷如何影響候鳥的遷徙路線。
reference: Scientists are studying how climate change affects the migration routes of migratory birds.

chinese: 與其抱怨環境，不如想辦法適應並改變它。
reference: Instead of complaining about the environment, we should try to adapt to it and change it.

chinese: 那位教授以其對細節的堅持聞名，這也是他的研究備受肯定的原因。
reference: That professor is known for his insistence on details, which is also why his research is highly recognized.

chinese: 一旦你養成每天閱讀的習慣，你會發現進步比你想像中快。
reference: Once you develop the habit of reading every day, you will find that you make progress faster than you expect.

chinese: 這場演講不僅讓聽眾更了解這個議題，也促使許多人開始採取行動。
reference: This speech not only helped the audience better understand the issue but also motivated many people to take action.

chinese: 智慧型手機不僅讓我們保持聯繫，也改變了我們吸收資訊的方式。
reference: Smartphones not only keep us connected but also change the way we absorb information.

chinese: 隨著全球暖化日益嚴重，我們迫切需要採取行動來減少碳排放。
reference: With global warming becoming increasingly serious, it is urgent that we take action to reduce carbon emissions.

chinese: 成功不是憑空而來的；相反地，它需要持續的努力與堅定的決心。
reference: Success does not come out of nowhere; instead, it requires continuous effort and firm determination.

chinese: 養成規律的運動習慣不僅有助於減輕壓力，也能增強免疫系統。
reference: Developing a habit of regular exercise not only helps relieve stress but also strengthens the immune system.

chinese: 許多現代人過度依賴速食，這對他們的長期健康造成了負面影響。
reference: Many modern people rely too heavily on fast food, which has a negative impact on their long-term health.

chinese: 無論遭遇多少困難，我們都不應該輕易放棄追求夢想。
reference: No matter how many difficulties we encounter, we should not easily give up pursuing our dreams.

chinese: 睡眠不足會導致注意力不集中，並增加發生意外的風險。
reference: Lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration and increase the risk of accidents.

chinese: 廣泛閱讀不僅能擴展我們的視野，也能激發我們的創造力。
reference: Reading widely can not only broaden our horizons but also inspire our creativity.

chinese: 網路霸凌是一個嚴重的社會問題，值得大家更多的關注與防範。
reference: Cyberbullying is a serious social issue that deserves more attention and prevention from everyone.

chinese: 有效的溝通是建立與維持良好人際關係的關鍵。
reference: Effective communication is the key to building and maintaining good interpersonal relationships.

chinese: 擔任志工能讓我們體會到幫助他人的喜悅，並培養同理心。
reference: Serving as a volunteer allows us to experience the joy of helping others and cultivate empathy.

chinese: 保護歷史古蹟免於被破壞是每一個公民的責任。
reference: It is every citizen's responsibility to protect historical monuments from being destroyed.

chinese: 現代青少年面臨來自學業與同儕的巨大壓力。
reference: Modern teenagers face enormous pressure from both their academic work and peers.

chinese: 鼓勵民眾搭乘大眾運輸工具是解決交通阻塞最有效的方法之一。
reference: Encouraging the public to take public transportation is one of the most effective ways to solve traffic congestion.

chinese: 我們應該把挫折視為學習的機會，而不是成功的絆腳石。
reference: We should regard setbacks as opportunities for learning rather than stumbling blocks to success.
